title: Canonical derived change-of-rings cochain model
statement: For a small site $\mathcal C$ with a sheaf morphism of commutative rings $\varphi:\mathcal O\to\mathcal O'$, and chosen derived categories of modules, define the canonical derived change-of-rings cochain model to be the object selected by $\operatorname{Nonempty}(\text{DerivedChangeOfRingsCochainModel}(\varphi))$ from [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Its ordinary extension is the prescribed sheafified scalar extension, and its derived functor, universal counit and K-flat computation are the fields of that model.
